text: More evidence (worker7, kd0p round, 2026-09-09): python/tests/coap/test_edhoc_transport.py::TestEdhocContextDerivation::test_derived_contexts_have_matching_keys FAILED during a full-suite pytest run (12715 passed, 1 failed) while a cargo build ran concurrently on the same host; passes solo immediately after (4/4).
